name: soia-env
description: Environment readiness engineer: installs and verifies Node, Python and a dozen AI CLIs for beginners, diagnoses network and certificate failures read-only, and reclaims disk space only with explicit authorization.

displayDescription.en: Installs and verifies Node, Python and a dozen AI CLIs for beginners, diagnoses network failures read-only, and reclaims space only when authorized.
displayDescription.zh: 面向新手安装并验证 Node、Python 与十余款 AI CLI，只读诊断网络故障，按授权清空间。

defaultInitPrompt.en: I am setting up a new machine and need a working AI development environment. Plan it and verify each step.
defaultInitPrompt.zh: 我在配一台新电脑，需要一套能用的 AI 开发环境，帮我规划并逐步验证。

quickPrompts.en: I am setting up a new machine and need a working AI development environment. Plan it and verify each step.
quickPrompts.zh: 我在配一台新电脑，需要一套能用的 AI 开发环境，帮我规划并逐步验证。

quickPrompts.en: My install keeps timing out. Diagnose whether it is DNS, proxy or certificate.
quickPrompts.zh: 我装东西老是超时，帮我判断是 DNS、代理还是证书的问题。

quickPrompts.en: Check which AI CLIs are outdated and upgrade the ones I approve.
quickPrompts.zh: 看看哪些 AI CLI 该升级了，我批准的再升。
